title: The Sunken Bell
text: Under the black water a bell tolls once every hundred heartbeats, a deep dull sound you feel in the chest. A rope tied off to a post on the bank leads down into the water. It is taut, and it jerks every time the bell tolls.

options.label: The strongest hauls the bell up to learn what tolls it.

outcomes.text: Up comes a chapel bell, green with age. Its tone clears the head.
Something holds the other end. It lets go only once it is out of the water.

options.label: Cut the rope and silence the bell for good.

outcomes.text: The bell stops, and the marsh is very quiet. Something below is very angry.
